message.content:
Here’s a mix of classics, modern hits, and hidden gems you might enjoy for a spooky Friday night:

| # | Title | Year | Why It’s Great |
|---|-------|------|----------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A psychological thriller with an iconic score and chilling atmosphere. |
| 2 | **Get Out** (2017) | Smart satire meets genuine terror—perfect for a modern twist. |
| 3 | **Hereditary** (2018) | Intense dread and a haunting family drama. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Suspense built around silence; great for a tense binge. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** (2019) | Daylight horror that feels unsettlingly bright. |
| 6 | **It Follows** (2014) | Creepy premise with a relentless, low‑key threat. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological horror that stays with you long after the credits roll. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | Classic haunted house vibes with solid scares. |
| 9 | **The Witch** (2015) | Slow‑burn dread set in Puritan New England. |
|10 | **Paranormal Activity** (2007) | Found‑footage style that makes the supernatural feel immediate. |

Feel free to pick one or two depending on how intense you want your Friday night to be!
